name: Panta OEM Diagnostics Expansion 7
usage_note: Curated from publicly archived OEM bulletins. Confirm exact VIN, engine family, emissions generation, ambient conditions, software level and current OEM procedure before repair.

documents.title: PACCAR MX-13 EPA2013 P1490 cold-weather EGR differential-pressure diagnosis
documents.source: NHTSA archived Peterbilt/PACCAR bulletin E178, released April 13 2017
documents.summary: Peterbilt bulletin E178 states that on PACCAR MX-13 EPA2013 engines, water can build up and freeze at the EGR pressure-difference sensor and set P1490, reported as EGR stuck open, potentially illuminating the stop-engine lamp. The bulletin specifically directs technicians to inspect freeze-frame ambient temperature: if activation occurred below 0 C / 32 F, follow the bulletin's extended test procedure before other diagnostics. Diagnostic lesson: P1490 in freezing conditions is not automatically proof of a failed EGR valve. Ambient conditions and moisture/freezing at the differential-pressure sensor are an OEM-recognized branch.

documents.title: PACCAR MX EPA13+ aftertreatment diagnosis uses prioritized diagnostic workflow
documents.authority: OEM PACCAR Technical Information Bulletin E198
documents.source: NHTSA archived PACCAR bulletin E198, released September 26 2017
documents.summary: PACCAR bulletin E198 introduced the Diagnostic Assistant for EPA13 and newer MX-11/MX-13 vehicles with aftertreatment problems. PACCAR describes the tool as prioritizing diagnostic steps toward the most likely root cause while capturing the final repair result. TruckFixHub lesson: Panta should emulate this workflow concept—rank likely causes and tests from the best applicable evidence, preserve vehicle/engine applicability, and use confirmed repair outcomes to improve future prioritization rather than presenting a flat list of possible causes.
